description: For questions about which citizenship by investment (second passport) programmes exist or what they start from: lists the 9 programmes GoodbyeMatrix prices (St Kitts and Nevis, Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, Vanuatu, Sao Tome and Principe, Nauru, Argentina) with region, route (contribution, investment or both), starting amount in USD for a single applicant, professional fee label, processing time, number of visa-free destinations where known, calculator and programme page links, and short notes.
name: list_cbi_programs

outputSchema.description: Same JSON as the GET programs endpoint of the GoodbyeMatrix pricing API.

restrictions.description: Public programme rule: excluded nationalities and countries of birth (ISO-2 code and name).

startingAmount.description: "From" amount in USD for a single applicant.

title: List CBI programmes
